ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.ssn_match != :dgm_block.ssn_match or
 :global.lastname_match != :dgm_block.lastname_match or
 :global.firstname_match != :dgm_block.firstname_match or
 :global.dob_match != :dgm_block.dob_match or
 :global.gender_match != :dgm_block.gender_match 
 then
 check_insert_rg('RG_DGM','C05C05C05C05C05',
 :GLOBAL.ssn_match||','||
 :GLOBAL.lastname_match||','||
 :GLOBAL.firstname_match||','||
 :GLOBAL.dob_match||','||
 :GLOBAL.gender_match||','
 ,'D',chk);
 end if;
IF 
 :global.ssn_match = :dgm_block.ssn_match and
 :global.lastname_match = :dgm_block.lastname_match and
 :global.firstname_match = :dgm_block.firstname_match and
 :global.dob_match = :dgm_block.dob_match and
 :global.gender_match = :dgm_block.gender_match 
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if 
 :dgm_block.ssn_match is not null and
 :dgm_block.lastname_match is not null and
 :dgm_block.firstname_match is not null and
 :dgm_block.dob_match is not null and
 :dgm_block.gender_match is not null
 then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM donor_grading_matrix
 WHERE 
 ssn_match = :dgm_block.ssn_match and
 lastname_match = :dgm_block.lastname_match and
 firstname_match = :dgm_block.firstname_match and
 dob_match = :dgm_block.dob_match and
 gender_match = :dgm_block.gender_match ;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('RG_DGM','C05C05C05C05C05', 
 :dgm_block.ssn_match||','||
 :dgm_block.lastname_match||','||
 :dgm_block.firstname_match||','||
 :dgm_block.dob_match||','||
 :dgm_block.gender_match||','
 ,'U',chk);

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('RG_DGM','C05C05C05C05C05',
 :dgm_block.ssn_match||','||
 :dgm_block.lastname_match||','||
 :dgm_block.firstname_match||','||
 :dgm_block.dob_match||','||
 :dgm_block.gender_match||','
 ,'U',chk);

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;
